modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the query to one authoritative SDR sensor, decode all signed coefficient and accuracy fields, and traverse next-reading links only with explicit cycle/bound controls.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a standards-based read and measurable oracle solely in the Review layer while retaining the source TBD.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A current sensor reading or SDR formula alone does not prove the command's factor-table response or next-reading behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sign/exponent mistakes can produce physically wrong converted values and contaminate later alert decisions; unsupported non-linear factor tables require explicit handling.

project_override_considerations: A vendor sensor API is equivalent only if raw factor coefficients, accuracy and table-selection behavior are traceable. A decoded engineering-unit value alone leaves 0x04/0x23 coverage unverified.
expected_evidence: Requested reading byte and query command
Decoded next reading, M, B, tolerance, accuracy and R/B exponents
Bounded table traversal or explicit single-entry scope

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items identify a standard factor query, but Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and generic setup clears evidence. DeepSeek refuses any method. Review preserves the gap and adds a conditional, fully parsed read-only path.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The query purpose and command schema family are identifiable. Sensor/reading inputs and expected factors are project readiness data; malformed or unsupported output can fail closed.

review_improvement: Turns a title-only case into a bounded coefficient-table verification with signed-field, accuracy and cycle checks while preventing any sensor mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sensor conversion factors are protocol data used to map raw readings to engineering units. A useful result requires exact bit-level decoding and a sensor-specific SDR cross-check, not merely command completion. Since the command is read-only and traversal can be strictly bounded, full automation is appropriate after project inputs are supplied.
